tldr: Major US stock indices experienced a significant decline, primarily driven by a tech sell-off amidst concerns over artificial intelligence and interest rates.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that President Trump's decision to pause new US sanctions against Russia would intensify the war.
The US federal deficit for the fiscal year that recently ended reached nearly $2 trillion, marking the largest budget gap since 2021.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite experienced a notable decline, with the S&P 500's tech sector recording its worst week in 18 months. This sell-off in technology stocks, particularly in software and chip sectors, was influenced by concerns regarding artificial intelligence and rising interest rates (MarketWatch, CNBC).

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield slightly increased to 5.1%, as the U.S. budget deficit swelled to nearly $2 trillion for fiscal year 2026. Treasury yields above 5% are increasing borrowing costs for both households and the federal government, posing a significant economic challenge (CNBC).

vix.why: The VIX, an indicator of market volatility, rose significantly. This increase is consistent with the broader market sell-off, especially in the tech sector, which was driven by investor concerns over AI developments and interest rates (MarketWatch).

watchlist.read: Near the bottom of its 1-month range and oversold on RSI. Big session: down 12.7% in a day.
Within 4% of its 1-month low. Big session: down 7.6% in a day.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate remained at 7.4% for the week ending October 15, according to Freddie Mac's weekly survey. The articles do not provide specific daily drivers for the weekly mortgage rate, which tracks the 10-year Treasury yield over recent days.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: Globally, solar power has for the first time surpassed nuclear power in terms of energy generation capacity.
Many websites are beginning to block autonomous AI agents from accessing their content, posing a challenge to AI tools designed to scour the internet.
Apple introduced its new foldable device, the iPhone Duo, featuring dual displays and Touch ID on the power button.

world.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that President Trump's decision to pause new US sanctions against Russia would escalate the conflict in Ukraine.
Pope Leo has been discharged from a Rome hospital after undergoing surgery to remove a cancerous tumor from his lung.
The United Arab Emirates has agreed with Saudi Arabia to re-engage in the Yemen conflict by resuming payments to Yemeni forces, following gains by Houthi fighters.

us.summary: The suspect in a deadly elementary school shooting in Bend, Oregon, which killed three children and one teacher, has been identified as a 16-year-old former student of the school.
The federal deficit for the fiscal year that just concluded reached nearly $2 trillion, marking the largest budget gap since 2021.
High winds are fueling fast-moving fires in Southern California, leading to the destruction of coastal homes and prompting thousands of evacuations.

science.summary: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists has updated its guidelines for treating symptoms commonly associated with menopause, marking the first revision since 2014.
A Russian man linked to the 2024 cyberattack on blood-test firm Synnovis, which affected London hospitals, has been arrested by German police.
